meta.aciklama:
Comment "DUBBED" and I'll DM you the link to the open-source voice studio that dubs your videos into 646 languages. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: how it works, and the catch.

1. You drop in a video. It transcribes it, translates every line and speaks it back, timed to the original.

2. You can review the translated text before it generates, and add more languages to the same project.

3. It clones a voice from one clean recording, so your dub can still sound like you.

4. It's free and open source (AGPL-3.0, past 96,000 GitHub stars) and runs on your own computer. The guide has the one prompt that makes Claude install it for you.

The catch: Claude sets it up and drives it, but the voice models run on your machine. Without a strong GPU it's slower, and quality depends on your recording. Only clone a voice you have the right to use.

For the link, comment "DUBBED".
